surfaceHistory._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surfaceHistory._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

THE CONFIG IS RIGHT AND THE DOMAIN IS MISSING.
_UNREACHABLE.fix: Point survivethedeletion.org at the project (DNS is at Namecheap; Vercel holds hostname claims only). Do NOT disable ssoProtection — it is deliberately shielding the vercel.app and disabling it would expose what the setting exists to protect.
_UNREACHABLE._note: HE IS THE ONLY HETERONYM WHOSE CARD A READER CANNOT REACH, and the position is the one whose whole condition is having been erased, seated on a site named for surviving deletion. The aptness does not make it acceptable.
